title: Websim Contribution Calendar
description: Unlock the pulse of your Websim journey with the Contribution Calendar! 🌟 This interactive visualization tool mirrors GitHub's iconic graph but tailored for the Websim community, showcasing your commits, collaborations, and creative sparks across projects. Track your daily activity with colorful blocks representing effort levels—from light green for casual contributions to fiery red for epic streaks 📈. Whether you're building immersive web simulations, debugging AI-driven experiences, or mentoring newcomers, this calendar gamifies your involvement, rewarding consistency with badges and leaderboards 🏆. Dive deeper into analytics: filter by project, time period, or team to uncover patterns in your productivity and growth. Celebrate milestones like 100-day streaks or major merges, and get motivated by top contributors' profiles. Integrated seamlessly with Websim's ecosystem, it fosters a sense of belonging and achievement, turning abstract efforts into tangible progress. Join thousands in visualizing impact—your calendar awaits! 🚀 (142 words)
